# WenQuanYi Bitmap Song 12px, Taiwan glyph forms (MOE standard): replacement glyphs.
#
# One glyph per line: code point, character, then 12 rows top to bottom, each 3 hex
# digits for the 12 dot columns (most significant bit = leftmost column). The grid is the
# 12px cell of the source face: row 11 is the row just below the roman baseline.
#
# Each line replaces that character's WQY glyph in the Taiwan-form (tc) face. Lines are
# drafted by component rules and reviewed or redrawn by hand, one component at a time:
#   艹 (2026-11-07): the crossbar opened between the two verticals; 291 Big5 common hanzi.
#   辶 (2026-11-07): a second bend (one dot moved left) in the drop; 123 Big5 common hanzi.
#   示 (2026-11-07): the middle vertical of a lower 示 ends straight, unhooked; 42 Big5 common hanzi.
#   戶 (2026-11-07): the first stroke is a bar, not a dot (each glyph redrawn by hand); 29 Big5 common hanzi.
#   smaller components (2026-11-08): 肖 青 令 前 骨 寺 有 也 昆 垂 丑 全 角 and 35 more, each glyph
#     checked against the MOE form and redrawn by hand where it differs; 253 Big5 common hanzi.
#   the rest (2026-11-08): characters under no shared component, each checked against the
#     MOE form and redrawn by hand where it differs; 246 Big5 common hanzi.
#   proofreading (2026-11-09): hand corrections from a per-radical review of the 12px and
#     16px faces, including some Big5 level 2 hanzi.
#
# Part of the source of a modified WenQuanYi Bitmap Song: GPL v2 with the font embedding
# exception, see LICENSE/GPL-2.0-font-exception.txt.
